The royal camp fills a white valley at the mouth of the
Grauklamm. North, over the treeline: the walls of
Weißenfels, black against the snow, and above them a
red smudge on the clouds where the forge burns.
It never goes out, the soldiers say.
Her Highness is at the red tent, up the road on the
right. She wants you there before the council starts.

parameters.desc: The royal camp. Rin holds a council at the red command tent, up the north road on the right.

parameters: desc = The royal camp. Rin holds a council at the red command tent, up the north road on the right.
The second bell. Sleep if you can; I won't.
Good, you're here. Sōma, Hikari: the three I told you
Mizushima Hikari, court battle-mage. So you're the
vessel. Hm. You look like a person.
Weißenfels. The lower city is the Host's now, full of
ghouls and thralls and empty armors. The citadel stands
on the rock above it behind one gate, and that gate is a
I found the old waterworks plans in the Wallfeste's
archive. An aqueduct runs from the north-west tower
down under the citadel. It fed the cisterns, before.
The forge is down there now. Its heat comes up the
old channels: you can see the steam from here. And the
winch house for the citadel gate sits right above it.
Two thousand men can take the lower city and hold the
square. Two thousand men can't climb a citadel.
So the army goes in through the south breach and draws
the Host onto itself. You three slip away to the tower,
down the aqueduct, through the forge, and open my gate.
And the people in the forge?
Are my brother's people. Every one of them comes out.
And whatever holds the citadel, Highness?
…The scouts call it the Iron Prince. It sits in the
great hall where my brother died, in armor I would know
I'll be at the gate when it opens. Whatever is in that
hall, I'm going to look it in the face.
The assault starts at the second bell, before dawn.
Eat. Sleep, if you can. The quartermaster has Wall stock
And the thralls on the road… yes, I heard. Sōma's
men will burn them. Everyone we can save, we save.

Before you go in. Nishiki's wife and girl, Mariko and
Aya. If they're alive in that forge…
He sold the Wall for them, and it turned him to brass.
Bring them out. It's the least the Wall owes him.

parameters.desc: Nishiki Eiji sold the Wall to buy back his wife and daughter. They are alive, working in the forge the Host built under Weißenfels. Saki asks you to bring them home: it's the least the Wall owes him.

parameters: desc = Nishiki Eiji sold the Wall to buy back his wife and daughter. They are alive, working in the forge the Host built under Weißenfels. Saki asks you to bring them home: it's the least the Wall owes him.

Mariko and Aya. The forge. Please.
The Marshal sent me with the army. Somebody has to
stitch them back together. Go see the princess.
Crown stock and Wall stock. The Crown's is dearer and
Second bell. I've been awake since the first.
The breach is south. They'll be waiting. So will we.
Royal guard. I was at Weißenfels six years ago. I ran.
The camp's fires burn low. Most of the soldiers are
May I ask you something, Falin?
When you woke inside the armor. Was it warm, or cold?
…Cold. And then warm, all at once, like a door opening.
Because that is what my Lord's waking felt like, from
the other end of the thread. And because I have seen one
soul in a borrowed body before, in my war.
It frightened me then. I was a frightened woman, most of
my life, and I called it anger.
You? No. Whoever made the armor you woke in does.
Kanta. You woke in a cave with nothing. I woke in the
snow with nothing. No mother, no village, no name but
Tomorrow I walk into the city I woke outside of. What if
Then you'll have a name with a story attached.
And if I don't like the story?
Then you'll still have the name. You earned it on your
own. Six years in a gap in a wall.
A camp fire. The soldiers make room for you.
The party's tent. Three bedrolls, one of them for show.
Second bell! On your feet! Column, form up!
In the dark the army goes up the valley without torches.
Snow squeaks under two thousand boots. Then a horn, and
the Crown's soldiers pour into the south breach.
Kanta! The north-west tower! I'll see you at my gate.

parameters.desc: The assault has begun. Slip away from the fighting to the north-west tower of the lower city and follow the aqueduct to the forge.

Not yet, my Lord. Falin is at the fire. Go and sit
with her a while; it's a long night.
You rest a while. (HP and MP restored.)
